prose:
Latent.Space’s interview introduction presents Linear’s shift from issue tracking toward coordinating human and agent work. The examined opening attributes growth and agent-created issue figures to the company and argues that agent usage should be assessed alongside use of the application itself.

The discussion also distinguishes broad customer adoption from a few large short-term AI contracts. Reported ARR and retention are company claims rather than audited figures here, and agent-created tickets do not measure completed or valuable work. This summary covers the examined opening of the long interview.
highlights: Interview frames a product and sales transition
Agent-created issues differ from completed work
Application usage is a separate signal
ARR is not realized cash or profit
Company metrics were not independently audited
